main_claim: Two complete unit-circle rims are bipartite when their centre separation exceeds 1+sqrt(3); this improves the independent-dominating-triple diameter boundary in the all-pairs-above-two region.
next_boundary: some centre separation at most two, or all separations above two with diameter at most 1+sqrt(3)
discarded_quick_architecture: The exact 23-vertex union of six pairwise Moser-spindle orientations at sqrt(3)-equilateral centres is four-colourable and permits all centres to share a colour; this exploratory rejection is not a global theorem.
